blockers.description: 10 unrecorded INVNO_TAG_CHRONOLOGY violations (D21): settlement rows naming invoices dated after them, so they cannot be paying those invoices. Worst is payment 38772 (2025-05-23, R-0.01) tagging invoice 48410 dated 2025-12-20 — 211 days early. Also 41598 (31d, 38d), 42549 x3 (8d, 9d, 10d), 38117 (14d), 37822 (4d), 39363 (1d), 40613 (1d). Each needs a ruling recorded in config/payment_tag_false_leads.json; a session-only decision does not survive regeneration. Does not change the financial close R20,061.51 — this is about which invoices the open list says are open.

The globalAgedDebtAsAt value of 2025-07-13 recorded in financials is contested and probably wrong by a year, which matters because agedDebt180Plus R20,061.49 is taken from that file's 120+ column. Two accounts now tie the snapshot to 13 July 2026: this account's own TXT running balance is exactly R20,061.51 on 13/07/2026 (DEBENQ_CURRENT.TXT line 676) against R26,633.43 on 13/07/2025, and BR0001 ties three ways to its 2026 statement. If the snapshot is 2026 then the ageing figure is 21 days stale, not 13 months. Do not correct the field here until the operator rules under H-032 — the vintage is portfolio-wide.
